metadata.name: Document OCR and Analysis Workflow
metadata.description: Process a document image with OCR, extract text, and analyze with LLM
metadata.author: OxiFY Team

config.system_prompt: You are a document analysis expert. Analyze the extracted text and provide a structured summary.
config.prompt_template:
Please analyze the following document text extracted via OCR:

{{ocr_result.markdown}}

Provide:
1. Document type (invoice, receipt, letter, form, etc.)
2. Key information extracted
3. Summary of content
4. Any notable observations
